description: Benchmark regression baseline measurements for Scavenger smart contract

participant_registration.description: Gas cost for participant registration operation

waste_submission.description: Gas cost for waste submission/recycling operation

waste_transfer.description: Gas cost for waste transfer between participants

waste_confirmation.description: Gas cost for confirming waste receipt/processing

incentive_creation.description: Gas cost for creating incentive structures

incentive_claim.description: Gas cost for claiming incentive rewards

query_global_metrics.description: Gas cost for querying global metrics (read-only)

query_participant_stats.description: Gas cost for querying participant statistics

batch_waste_transfer.description: Gas cost for batch waste transfer operations

metadata.note: Higher tolerance due to variable batch sizes

material_submission.description: Gas cost for material submission operations

notes.measurement_methodology: Benchmarks measured using Soroban SDK testutils with env.cost_estimate(). Values are CPU instruction counts.
notes.tolerance_explanation: Tolerance allows for minor variations due to Soroban runtime differences, contract dependencies, and storage state variations. Default 5% tolerance; higher tolerance for batch operations that are more variable.
notes.update_procedure: Use performance/generate-baseline.js to update baselines with new measurements. NEVER change baseline to silence regressions; investigate root cause first.
notes.regression_detection: Run performance/analyze-results.js to check for regressions. Fails CI if any metric exceeds (baseline * (1 + tolerance_percent/100)).
notes.historical_context: Version 1.0.0 establishes initial baselines. See BENCHMARK_REGRESSION.md for update history and rationale.
